verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists "Advanced call summaries, including custom summaries," which shows first-party support for shaping summary output beyond one generic format. The API also exposes named meeting types, usable as a filter on GET /meetings. Nothing in the evidence shows templates or saved prompts tied to a meeting type such as discovery, 1:1 or standup. missing for 10: documentation of how custom summary templates are authored, evidence that templates can be assigned per meeting type, saved-prompt support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
